title: Pig in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f7a8b8'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#fbcdd6'/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#e8869a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#e8869a'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d4637a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d4637a'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#f7a8b8'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#fbcdd6'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='25' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#f7a8b8' transform='rotate(-20 30 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='25' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#f7a8b8' transform='rotate(20 70 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='26' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#e8869a' transform='rotate(-20 31 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='26' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#e8869a' transform='rotate(20 69 26)'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='4' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='4' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e8869a'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b84d63'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b84d63'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 56 Q50 61 57 56' stroke='#b84d63' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M28 60 Q50 70 72 60 Q72 66 50 74 Q28 66 28 60Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- Scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q50 71 70 62' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail hanging down -->
  <path d='M65 64 Q70 72 68 82 Q64 84 62 80 Q63 72 62 66Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail stripe -->
  <path d='M64 68 Q67 74 66 80' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Curly tail -->
  <path d='M76 65 Q84 60 82 68 Q80 74 74 72' stroke='#e8869a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
